headline: Measles outbreak: Death toll reaches 1,175 as four die in 24 hours
summary: Bangladesh reports 988 new suspected measles cases in 24 hours, with 61 confirmed. The Health Directorate urges vigilance as the disease continues to spread nationwide.

headline: 7 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi road crash
summary: A child was among the seven dead and 15 others injured when a truck hit a bus carrying Bangladeshis returning from Medina to Jeddah.
details: Seven Bangladeshis, including a child, were killed in a road accident in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on Saturday.
The victims were traveling from Medina to Jeddah when a truck hit their bus from behind.
Fifteen other Bangladeshis were injured in the crash and are currently receiving treatment at a local hospital.
The deceased, who belonged to several Bangladeshi families, have been kept in the hospital morgue.
The Bangladesh Consul General in Jeddah confirmed the incident and noted that the consulate has formally requested details from local authorities regarding the casualties.
The accident occurred early Saturday morning while the passengers were on their way back to Jeddah.
caption:
7 Bangladeshis, including a child, killed in a Saudi Arabia road crash.

Seven Bangladeshis, including a child, were killed in a road accident in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, on Saturday.

The victims were traveling from Medina to Jeddah when a truck hit their bus from behind.

Fifteen other Bangladeshis were injured in the crash and are currently receiving treatment at a local hospital.

The deceased, who belonged to several Bangladeshi families, have been kept in the hospital morgue.

The Bangladesh Consul General in Jeddah confirmed the incident and noted that the consulate has formally requested details from local authorities regarding the casualties.

The accident occurred early Saturday morning while the passengers were on their way back to Jeddah.
